tools.name: scenario_run
tools.description: Run a verified scenario end to end. The node-container adapter arranges isolated reads, starts the actual service, invokes actions, independently observes effects and always stops. The test-run adapter runs reviewed real project tests with verified multi-DB fixtures and checks the independent observation report. Poll with job if still running; proof levels and unsupported boundaries remain explicit.

tools.name: tool_execute
tools.description: Execute one discovered enabled tool with its exact arguments. Uses the same validation, rate limits, trace and permissions as calling that tool directly, and preserves its visualization. Call tool_describe first. Cannot recursively call discovery dispatchers.

tools.name: api_request_save
tools.description: Save a prepared/captured request as a reusable normal script in collection/name. Preserves route/source provenance, typed params, assertions, captures and supplied hooks. Collection vars/before/after/finally work through the existing script engine. Does not execute. Cookies are omitted and secrets become required runtime placeholders. Existing script requires overwrite=true.

tools.name: collection_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a running collection. Stops new actions and interrupts JS/HTTP operations, then executes finally hooks with separate cleanup deadlines. Generic in-flight tools may finish with an unknown outcome; their actions are never retried on cancellation.

tools.name: collection_check
tools.description: Check a durable collection run independently. Success requires a finished passed run with every selected case executed and no failed assertions, infrastructure errors, skipped cases or cleanup failures.

tools.name: collection_plan
tools.description: Build an offline ordered plan of nested suite cases. Expands datasets and matrix values with isolated per-case vars, records tags, selection exclusions, source revisions and seed. Maximum 1000 cases. No hooks, tool calls or HTTP requests execute.

tools.name: collection_save
tools.description: Update collection metadata without clearing omitted fields. Suite uses the existing script language: ordered script/collection references, tags, datasets, matrix, shared params and before/after/finally JavaScript hooks. Collection hooks remain per-script; suite hooks execute once per selected scope.

tools.name: ddl_snapshot
tools.description: DDL of a synced database (schemas, extensions, enum/domain types, sequences, tables with defaults, identity, constraints, indexes, comments, functions, procedures, views in order, triggers) for tests: all of it, or only some tables, functions or what a service uses, closed over what they need (FK targets, trigger functions, called functions and their tables). With workspace, written to <module>/src/test/resources/dt-schema/<db>.sql (or path).
